summary: Wake host-local launch diagnostics from authoritative prompt and executable input dependencies

schema.detail: Watch inputs remain host-local and are not persisted in launch receipts.

rules.detail: Absent candidates, transitive imports, render reads, executable resolution probes and recursive rules trees invalidate incremental capture. Background identity completion wakes reconciliation.

compatibility.detail: Unresolved executables and failed identity measurements remain diagnostic and unknown, not reconcile-stage faults. Subscription failures use a seat-scoped daemon fault. No refresh controller, admission seal or runtime actuation is enabled.

manual.detail: No configuration change or operator read is required to register local watches.

recovery.detail: Watches are rebuilt from current declarations and dependency paths after restart or invalidation.
